newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson soars 5 pct to record levels.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson soars 5 pct to record levels.

text.p: Shares in Swedish telecoms firm LM Ericsson AB soared on heavy buying pressure from abroad in part due to an upgrade by Goldman Sachs to its priority list from market outperformer.
By 1300 GMT the share was 9.50 crowns higher at 188 crowns, a rise of more than five percent. The share touched an intra-day high of 189 crowns during morning trade, its highest ever.
The jump was a combination of factors, one broker said.
He said these included heavy pressure from abroad, buyers from everywhere, an option expiry today, and upgrading by several firms such as Goldman Sachs.
Another broker said the reason was less clear.
"There's a rumour in the market that you shouldn't be short in Ericsson," he said.
